business_definition: Unique identifier for each applicant (for example, AP-10001)
Self-reported or verified gross annual income in USD
Length of time with the applicant's current employer in months
Baseline credit score at profile creation; expected range is 300 to 850
Internal credit classification: Excellent, Good, Fair, or Subprime
Geographic market region: Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, Southwest, or West
Applicant's date of birth; applicant should be at least 18 years old
Employment category: employed, self-employed, or retired
Housing arrangement: Rent, own, or other
Two-letter abbreviation for the applicant's state of residence
Date and time when the applicant record was submitted
Unique identifier for each credit pull event (for example, EV-10001)
Identifier linking the event to applicants.applicant_id
Code linking the event to loan_products.product_code
Date when the credit bureau pull occurred
Applicant's debt-to-income ratio as a percentage at the time of the credit pull
Score returned by the bureau; 300 to 850 when present and blank when the pull fails
Tier-change result: No_Change, Upgraded, Downgraded, or Not_Applicable
Credit bureau requested: EQUIFAX, EXPERIAN, or TRANSUNION
Operational result of the pull: SUCCESS, FAILED, or PENDING
Failure reason; required for failed pulls and blank for successful pulls
Unique tracking identifier returned by the bureau provider
Underwriting category: Low Risk, Moderate Risk, High Risk, Very High Risk, or Review
Indicates whether the credit pull event record is active
Unique identifier for each loan application (for example, LA-10001)
Identifier linking the application to applicants.applicant_id
Code linking the application to loan_products.product_code
Date and time when the application decision was recorded
Underwriting result: Approved, Denied, or Under Review
Loan amount approved; zero when no amount has been approved
Approved repayment term in months; zero when no term has been approved
Identifier of the source document supporting the decision
Identifier of the underwriting policy applied to the decision
Identifier of the policy rule that produced or escalated the decision
Unique product code: MNT-01 for term loans or REV-02 for revolving credit
Credit score ranges used to assign underwriting risk categories
Baseline annual percentage rate before adjustments
Maximum principal amount or credit limit that may be issued
Descriptive name of the credit product
Minimum permitted term length in months
Maximum permitted term length in months
Maximum permitted debt-to-income ratio expressed as a percentage
